inputBoundary: Pre-NotationScore-bridge stateful MIDI-profile events expressed as MIDI pitches plus musical values
outputBoundary: BRF/Braille-ASCII plus Unicode Braille Patterns and an auditable spelling trace

state.accidentals: Measure-scoped; reset to active key-signature defaults at each measure boundary; state is keyed by spelled note and written octave.
state.octaves: First musical note is marked; thereafter apply MBC 2015 melodic interval rules for fourth/fifth/greater-than-fifth skips.
state.signatureEffect: Initial key/meter serialization forces an octave mark on the first following note.
state.chords: Highest sounding note written; remaining members encoded as downward intervals; duplicates and >octave compound intervals fail closed.
state.measures: Single Braille blank separates measures; accidental state resets at each boundary.

midiProfileDecisions.generatedAccidentals: Generated-score accidentals are emitted as notation required by the deterministic MIDI profile; they are not prefixed as corrections to an existing print source.
midiProfileDecisions.chordDisclosure: Structured output carries the MIDI_GENERIC_UPPER_NOTE_DOWNWARD_INTERVALS_V1 profile id so UI/docs can disclose interval direction.

supported: stateful simple chords within one octave
